Sevana Pension Direct To Home Module
is the application software deployed for the distribution of Social Security Pensions through Co-Operative Banks within the Kerala state with the intention of providing efficient and transparent mechanism in the social security services executed through them. This application is being used by the Co-Operative Banks to disburse Social welfare pensions in a time bound manner.
